message.content:
Go to the **PreLicenseTraining.com login page** and sign in with your login name and password; your login name may be your email address.[1]

- If you forgot your password, use the **Forgot Password** page and enter the email address tied to your account to receive reset instructions.[2]
- If you are a **mentor** using PSI Learning Academy, there is a separate **Mentor Portal** password reset page.[3]
- If you are trying to create or access a new account, the site also has a **register** page with a “Login!” option for existing users.[6]

If you want, I can also help you find the correct login page for a specific PreLicenseTraining program or school.
